raw:
SELECT 
    s."OpenDate" as charter_auth_date,
    AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") as avg_free_meal_rate_2014_2015
FROM main."schools" s
JOIN main."frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."Charter" = 1
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND s."OpenDate" <= '2015-09-01'
GROUP BY s."OpenDate"
ORDER BY s."OpenDate"
